name: NL compiler — compile English macro via /api/skill/compile-natural
description: Verifies the NL compiler returns a valid steps array for a simple English instruction. Always proxies through the portfolio backend (compile-natural -> AWS Bedrock, server-side only) using the signed-in user's JWT, so it requires a real cloud-relay auth token and network access. Gated behind EVAL_ALLOW_LLM=1 and skipped by default in CI/local `npm run eval` runs.

body.description: open notepad and type hello world
